Landed and applied 2026-11-02. Gerrit change 3222 (patchset 1, ae09b0a42e7) got LLM-Review +1 (4 advisory comments, 0 unresolved) and Verified +1 (CI run 41528192140); submitted with scripts/gerrit_safe_submit.py at 13:51:05 PST, merged as 49e3dead5fa1eb1e0c51b0df979f3d7b82ab5f18.
Production apply (narrow runbook path, no compose-up.sh; SSM 5c3dc148-4256-41dd-86d8-73f12187761b): backup /var/gerrit/site/etc/gerrit.config.bak-20261102T215139Z; key set at 13:51:39 PST; quiet-window check (no receive-pack/submit in the preceding 90 s; show-queue only the 6 periodic tasks) passed on the 3rd check, the earlier hits being this session's own submit; docker restart compose-gerrit-1 at 13:52:39 PST; HTTP 200 locally at 13:53:00 PST.
Live checks: git config -f /var/gerrit/site/etc/gerrit.config --get receive.checkReferencedObjectsAreReachable = false (also false inside the container); public https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/config/server/version = 200. Ordinary push with no packing flags from a clone whose gerrit/main was 40 commits behind (base 594604edd90, without 49e3dead) was accepted as WIP change 3241 at 13:54:30 PST, then abandoned; error_log has 0 MissingObjectException/FullConnectivityChecker lines since the restart (SSM 25651db9-b1c2-44af-bbe3-b723b63dac1d). Replication start --all --wait completed successfully; python -m rebar.mirror_guard --replication --merged-reachability --merged-limit 50 exited 0 (in sync; all 50 merged revisions reachable from main; Gerrit main 49e3dead5fa). Limit: that probe used a stale base but did not recreate the exact open-change .have boundary of the f3db case, so it shows ordinary pushes succeed with the check off, not a replay of that exact pack.
